verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists "记忆" (memory) among its general assistant features, which points to a first-party memory capability. However, the pack gives no detail on whether memory carries context from previous chats into new conversations or how it is applied. The million-token context window is in-session context, not cross-chat memory, so it is not credited. missing for 10: documentation of cross-conversation recall and how remembered context is applied in new chats, user controls for viewing/editing memories, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
